name: core-comments
description: Comments, the core's conversation on an instance (D77, batch 1): post, its replies, quotes, blocks and retries; edit and listEdits; deleteMessage and purge; reactions and listReactions; pins; resolve and reopen; listMessages' four anchors and getMessage; the record's thread members and the three volatile fields; the refusals, each with its code and details; every write beside the instance, which keeps its seq and appends an event of no sequence; the access policy's questions; delete; and its rule for a new version.
